fusions.name: Pull the Loose End
fusions.desc: Hooks a loose end on the first enemy it meets and pulls. It deals 15 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target, and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Winding Sheet
fusions.desc: Winds a sheet around every enemy within 3 tiles. It deals 28 damage that ignores resistances and leaves each [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Whipstitch
fusions.desc: Stitches a wound shut and binds it. It restores 18 health to you, with a 10% chance to heal critically.

fusions.name: Shared Selvedge
fusions.desc: Conjures a cloak woven of strands: your critical hit chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 0.15x more, your maximum health rises by 10 and each kill returns 2 health. Its effect increases by 5% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
